title: ACP Note
description: Minimal exchange unit: a human's intent bound to a revision and the refs it applies to. See ACP v0.2 §5.1.

artifact.description: Artifact identifier as registered with the implementation.

rev.description: L1 revision identifier the refs were minted in (full or truncated hash).

intent.description: The human's own words, preserved verbatim (ACP-5.1-03).

refs.description: L3 refs. Every ref MUST resolve in `rev` at acceptance time (ACP-5.1-02).

op.description: Optional machine interpretation of the intent. Never replaces `intent`.

status.description: Core states. Profile extensions MUST be namespaced (ACP-5.1-04).

actor.description: Who created the note, e.g. human:alice or agent:dana.

result_rev.description: Revision produced by handling this note.
